mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in the last month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over the last quarter signals strong economic demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to grow.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the quarters where GDPC1 showed a positive increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% in the last two months indicates a supply-side contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it signals reduced economic output and potential disruptions in supply chains.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 1% in the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 300,000 in the last month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate, signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and confidence rise.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 300k in 1 month and UNRATE decreases
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 300k and UNRATE decreased.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in housing starts by more than 10% in the last two months indicates a surge in demand for new homes, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it signals strong consumer demand and economic growth.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 10% in the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as it provides a favorable environment for equity investments.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the periods where CPIAUCSL remained below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures by more than 1% in the last month, coupled with a rise in the unemployment rate, signals a weakening demand environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and confidence fall.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases > 1% in 1 month and UNRATE increases
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS decreased by more than 1% and UNRATE increased.
